roomMedia.scope: Actual local LiveKit SFU + Chromium audio/WebRTC + Firestore SDK/emulator + application runtime/routes/readiness/transfer controller. External WhatsApp connector and Meta events are explicitly synthetic; no real phones, Meta, FCM, cloud or production deployment.

checks.name: real incoming: exact production readiness verifies bidirectional RTP and decoded tones
initial acoustic silence establishes real RTP and decoded readiness before the customer speaks
initial provider-confirmed customer mute connects transport honestly and later resumes two-way audio
real outgoing: customer answer, 25-second healthy call, silence, mute and immediate callback
competing incoming answers: actual transactions choose one owner and one customer audio leg
decline and customer-cancel before answer never create media and release the next call
real A-to-B-to-A audio handoff survives source shutdown and rejects old-leg End
transfer decline and target missing audio preserve source media; false evidence cannot commit
runtime restart reloads Firestore ownership without creating a second customer call
customer hangs up during transfer: terminal state wins and both real operator legs disconnect
real route boundary rejects unauthenticated, invalid and revoked-device mutations
lost Accept acknowledgement resumes the original actual media leg without accepting twice
lost Dial acknowledgement plus early answer reconnects exact original call and one audio leg
duplicate End after an ignored HTTP acknowledgement cannot leave busy reservations or repeat customer termination
actual SDK signaling and full WebRTC reconnection restore both decoded audio directions
real invitation timeout releases target while customer and source audio continue
one-way microphone publication cannot become Connected until both actual directions recover
R23 joins real audio during a delayed Accept and wakes exact operators on transfer changes

r23EarlyJoinMeasurement.name: R23 early Answer before blocked connector, real room join

limits: No physical Android handset timing or live customer call was run. Scenario duration includes fixtures and assertions; it is not call setup latency.
Media tests use a real SFU/WebRTC/RTP with generated tones, a synthetic WhatsApp connector and Firestore emulator.
Production provider Dial previously took 2782–3156 ms; no universal sub-2-second guarantee is supported.
The 1–2 s action and 4–5 s transfer limits remain real-phone acceptance targets.
